scope: PR 38 Commit 4: the consolidated research report of an accepted run, migrated read-only from its v1 packages; no model, artifact or label is read

historical_v1_sources.note: SHA-256 of each v1 package table as written by its generator (historical). The tables need not exist after the migration: report --check reproduces every one from this report (and the frozen baseline) and compares it with these checksums. The packages' own --check (complementarity, s1-report) needs their tables and runs only while they exist.

pre_post_ratios.from: outer join of the frozen pr37_stage2_pre_correction_v1 ratios with complementarity_v1/diagnostics/ratios (08_diagnostic_ratios.csv); pre - post

pre_post_states.from: outer join of the frozen pr37_stage2_pre_correction_v1 states with complementarity_v1/diagnostics/states (03_routing_states.csv); pre - post

baseline_comparison.from: outer join of the GLASS rows of the frozen pr37_stage2_pre_correction_v1 ratios and of both packages' diagnostics/ratios (08_diagnostic_ratios.csv)

ratios_comparison.from: outer join of diagnostics/ratios of both packages (08_diagnostic_ratios.csv); full - oof_remainder

states_comparison.from: outer join of diagnostics/states of both packages (03_routing_states.csv); full - oof_remainder

verification.method: every v1 package table reproduced byte for byte from the report (kept tables) or by its rebuild (excluded tables)

01_registered_outcomes.csv.title: Registered outcomes with 95% paired bootstrap intervals, pooled and per fold: GLASS vs RF (D-C1 statements) and pre vs post correction per arm

02_router_metrics.csv.title: Router metric tables (numerator, denominator, value, status) per fold and pooled, corrected and pre/post correction, and their fold dispersion

03_routing_states.csv.title: Three-state routing: counts, shares and class composition, and state transitions (pre to post correction; S1 oof_remainder to full)

04_unique_contribution.csv.title: Pass 2 discovery against the frozen LR/EBM references, cross-router overlap, the common eligible population and chance baselines

05_matched_budget.csv.title: The frozen LR/EBM reference flags, label-free rate-matched selections and each router's Pass 1 set against the matched LR set

06_agreement_diagnostics.csv.title: Router-reference contingency, cross-router crosstab, LR/EBM disagreement and observed-versus-expected

07_score_strata.csv.title: Routing by score stratum, and stratum contrasts

08_diagnostic_ratios.csv.title: Every Step 2A-2D count and ratio (numerator, denominator, value, status)

09_contract_compliance.csv.title: Fit-time obligations and observed outer-OOF shortfalls (kept apart), F31 R2 strips, R3 optimism and M6 inner-OOF Pass 1

10_solver_and_validation.csv.title: Fold ledger, solver outcomes, three-state accounting, trace and alignment checks, routing-policy audit and signal availability

11_s1_sensitivity.csv.title: S1 (GLASS pass2_population full vs oof_remainder): configuration, Pass 2 fitting populations, fold feasibility and G6 Pass 1 invariance

code.method: sha256 of the UTF-8 file with CRLF normalised to LF
